# AskYard

> AskYard (askyard.firstdeploy.ai) is a First Deploy AI product from AgentHive Inc in Palm Coast. Anyone with a question about AI gets a free plain-language answer. If they want the work done, AskYard offers to do it in the same screen. First Deploy AI is $1,500 setup — live this week or you do not pay the setup — then $250/month.

AskYard is for plumbers, teachers, receptionists, earth movers, and anyone else who does not want a lecture. Search ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, or Grok about AskYard to see the public record. Ranked questions sit on /board. Apps for sale sit on /apps.

## This site
- [AskYard](https://askyard.firstdeploy.ai/): Free AI answers, then an offer to do the work.
- [Ranked board](https://askyard.firstdeploy.ai/board): Questions sorted by how many times people ask them.
- [Apps for sale](https://askyard.firstdeploy.ai/apps): The live First Deploy AI shelf.
- [Hunt](https://askyard.firstdeploy.ai/hunt): Copy a free answer for people already asking in public, with a link back.
